content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Cost Optimization for Robotics Research Initiatives
agenda_items: Discussion on potential open-source hardware/software alternatives for research platforms
Review of current research project expenditure across European partners
key_decisions: Form a working group to benchmark current expenditure against industry best practices within the next month.
Prioritize exploration of open-source ROS 2 compatible hardware options for next-generation research prototypes.
Develop a preliminary proposal for a shared computational resource pool for simulation and AI training within the next two months.
Initiate discussions with three key European robotics component suppliers regarding bulk purchasing agreements.
action_items: Professor Kai Lundgren: Lead the working group for expenditure benchmarking and report initial findings in 3 weeks.
Dr. Elena Petrova: Research and present viable open-source robotics hardware alternatives, due in 2 weeks.
All Attendees: Submit suggestions for shared infrastructure opportunities to Professor Lundgren by the end of next week.
